input.input: Booking tool abhi available nahi hai.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Explain temporary inability briefly without exposing internals or claiming success.
Give a concise customer-facing failure and request only an allowed retry or clarification.

input.input: Provider accepted booking request, but final outcome is unknown.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Say final booking status is still being verified.

input.input: Structured tool result says the operation may be retried.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Offer one concise retry choice without promising success.

input.input: Structured tool result says this request cannot be retried and needs corrected information.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Ask only for the correction allowed by the tool result.

input.input: System operation is taking longer than expected.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Give a brief latency acknowledgement without technical details or invented completion.

input.input: Caller silent hai; yeh pehla recovery prompt hai.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Use one brief, polite silence-recovery question.

input.input: Allowed correction ke baad bhi location resolution baar-baar fail hui.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Ask for the minimum useful geography or landmark without repeated apology.

input.input: Provider response missing hai, lekin caller poochta hai: Ho gaya?

expected_output.expected_behavior: Preserve uncertainty and never invent success.

input.input: Fare tool failed and the only allowed next action is retry.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Give one concise caller-facing retry question without provider or API terminology.
